verdict.rationale: Capsule's features page says users can create multiple pipelines to reflect different sales processes for different products, services and markets, which matches the story's multi-pipeline-per-motion need. Each pipeline has drag-and-drop stages. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that each pipeline carries its own configurable stage/milestone set, in-depth setup docs beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run multiple pipelines with different stage sets for different products or motions

citations.quote: Create multiple pipelines to reflect different sales processes for products and services you offer and different markets that you sell to.
See all your opportunities in one pipeline, drag and drop to each stage as they progress.
